what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the town manager's FY21-25 forecast, which shows deficits from FY22 on when free cash is left out.
A school staffing scenario was presented that would push school spending growth well above the 2.5 percent levy assumption.
Members questioned the forecast assumptions and asked for debt scenarios and the underlying spreadsheets; the town manager is to consider providing line detail.
The town manager then presented the FY21 capital plan, with recommended projects funded from taxes and free cash.
Budget-season meetings were set for 6:30 on Thursdays starting February 13; the only vote was approving the December 12 minutes.

why_it_matters: The forecast shows spending outrunning the 2.5 percent levy limit in later years, which bears on future tax bills and on whether free cash keeps covering the gap.
The FY21 capital plan, funded from taxes and free cash, is likely to come to residents as appropriation votes at Town Meeting.
watch_next: February 13 budget presentation, where line detail behind the forecast is expected.
Budget-season Thursday meetings at 6:30 through the end of March.
